Subject: Zenora Health — Steward activation brief and mutual action plan

Team — placing the Zenora Health activation into the inbox for stewardship and primary owner assignment. Quick summary up front, followed by asks.

Deal snapshot
- Account: Zenora Health (payer-facing telehealth network)
- ARR (first 12 months): $480,000 (annualized) — signed SOW attached (v3)
- Primary contacts: Elena Park (Biz Ops), Shaun Li (Procurement)
- HS deal id: HS-4521 / Redwood deal ZD-4521

Goals & high level timeline
- Kickoff (customer-facing): Target week of Apr 24 (customer proposed)
- Technical intake & sandbox by Apr 30
- Pilot (10 clinics) May 15–Jun 5
- Production go-live: Target Jun 6, 2028

Critical integrations / constraints
- Data ingress: nightly EHR exports via SFTP (partner: Mirth)
- Auth: Okta SAML (customer-managed) — they require a sample Okta config and metadata exchange
- Data residency: US-West (required)
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence required before production cutover
- Peak tokens per request (est): ~1.6k, average concurrent requests: 45

Acceptance criteria (customer expects these before go-live)
1) Sandbox ingest of historical 14-day dataset + verification report
2) Stable SSO login for 20 pilot users
3) Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for read-only inference calls during pilot load profile
4) Runbook and rollback plan validated with customer ops

Attachments: Zenora_SOW_v3.pdf (final, countersigned by legal), Zenora_MAP_20280410.xlsx (mutual action plan), okta-setup-guide.md (template)

Immediate asks
- Monica: please own the CS kickoff and primary success plan. Confirm field owner + first 30/60/90 deliverables.
- Karthik: own the technical intake, SFTP sample, and Okta metadata exchange.
- Tessa: schedule the customer-facing kickoff and send calendar invites (Elena requested week of Apr 24).
- Sales -> CS handoff notes: any open credit/discount approvals (none beyond what was captured in HS-4521), finance billing contact is procurement@zenorahealth.com.

I'll remain available for the initial kickoff. Posting a Slack channel request (#zenora-go-live) once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
